capture._comment_region: All region values are FRACTIONS of screen width/height (0.0-1.0), NOT pixel coordinates. This keeps the same config working across different resolutions, as long as Warframe's UI scale is left at default (100%).
capture._comment_calibration: To calibrate: screenshot the relic reward screen, measure the pixel box around the reward names, then divide by screen width/height to get fractions. e.g. on a 1920x1080 screenshot, if the box starts at x=560 and is 800px wide: left = 560/1920 = 0.2917, width = 800/1920 = 0.4167

region._comment: Calibrated at 1920x1080 (confirmed 27in 1080p monitor) against a real 4-reward screen with mixed 1-line and 2-line wrapped names. Box verified visually to fully contain text with no clipping and no player-name row bleed-in.
